_doc: Motedis' slot nut with a spring (Nutenstein mit Feder) for its B-type 10 mm slot, M8. Sold as M4, M5, M6 and M8, each drawn with the same body. Motedis gives no hold.
name: slot-nut-10-motedis-m8-roll-in

slot.rule: Motedis' B-type 10 mm slot, which is Rexroth's (slot-10-bosch): Motedis sells B-type profiles to Rexroth's dimensions

thread.rule: Thread M8, sold as M4, M5, M6, M8
thread.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 10 M8 (S10BSSNM8), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S10BSSNM8-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-10-M8

nut_kind.rule: Swivelled in through the opening after assembly; a leaf spring holds it in an upright beam

length.rule: Along the slot: 20 on the drawing
length.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 10 M8 (S10BSSNM8), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S10BSSNM8-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-10-M8

width.rule: Across the slot: 14 on the drawing
width.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 10 M8 (S10BSSNM8), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S10BSSNM8-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-10-M8

height.rule: The body under the lips: 5,3 on the drawing (its leaf spring reaches 11,7 below the tongue's top)
height.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 10 M8 (S10BSSNM8), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S10BSSNM8-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-10-M8

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening: 9,9 on the drawing
tongue_width.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 10 M8 (S10BSSNM8), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S10BSSNM8-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-10-M8

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step: 1,5 on the drawing
tongue_height.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 10 M8 (S10BSSNM8), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S10BSSNM8-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-10-M8

nut_entry.rule: Put in through the opening anywhere along the slot

material.rule: Material as the product page names it

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its swivel-in block with a spring in an 8 mm slot (M8) at 2200 N, taken here for the larger 10 mm nut as the lower bound. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m8 thread set (ISO 898-1)
